conversation.contentPreview: Write a snake game in javascript, css, html in one file. Build a classic Snake game on a 30x30 grid. The snake moves continuously in one of four directions and grows when eating food. If it hits a wall or itself, the game ends. Implement keyboard controls for player movement. Add a CPU-controlled snake mode that automatically searches for food. Add the three game modes: human vs human, cpu vs human, cpu vs cpu. Display the score during gameplay. Include a start menu and game over screen. Allow restarting the game with a keypress. Use file name "snake_ollama-north-mini-code-1.0-latest_01.html"
